title: Thus Spoke Poet Kalidasa
subtitle: A Coal-Town’s Shadows and Subtle Schemes
summary: When the enigmatic detective Byomkesh Bakshi is called to a bustling coal city plagued by mysterious sabotage, he uncovers more than just industrial unrest. Amidst the sooty chaos and hidden agendas, every face could be an ally—or a foe. Follow Byomkesh as he navigates a web spun from secrets, danger, and intrigue.
